summary: Dashboard goal card: progress ring with the percentage in the center, current value and target formatted with Intl, and how much is left to reach the goal.
whenToUse: Showing progress toward a numeric goal (sales, sign-ups, budget).
Pairing KpiCard with an indicator that has an explicit target.
whenNotToUse: Values without a target: use KpiCard or Statistic.
Progress of an ongoing operation (upload, loading): use Progress.
Multiple goals compared in the same chart: use a bar or radial chart.

props.name: label
props.description: Goal name; also the accessible name of the meter.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of the value, target, and remaining amount (currency, percentage…).

props.name: footer
props.description: Link to details, a small action, or a note.

props.name: tone
props.description: Ring color; brand uses the accent gradient.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: When set, the label becomes a heading of that level.

inherits: HTML attributes of <div> (id, style, data-*, aria-*).
accessibility: The ring is a role="meter" with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax equal to the target, aria-valuenow, and aria-valuetext (formatted percentage, value, and target); its name comes from the label via aria-labelledby.
The SVG is decorative (aria-hidden): value, target, and remaining amount are visible text.
Reaching the goal is stated in text (“Obiettivo raggiunto”), not conveyed by color alone.
With prefers-reduced-motion the ring doesn't animate; in forced-colors mode it uses Highlight on a GrayText track.
responsive: Ring and figures sit side by side and wrap in narrow containers.
Use Grid with minItemWidth for rows of goals.
customization: Tokens: --dc-look-radius-container, --dc-color-action-primary and --dc-color-accent-default (brand gradient), feedback colors for success/warning, --dc-color-surface-muted for the track.
commonMistakes: Passing the percentage as value with target 100 when you have absolute values: you lose the format (currency, unit).
Using tone="success" for a goal that is far off: the color must reflect the actual status.
Formatting numbers by hand and ignoring the locale.

examples.name: Tones
examples.title: Tones
examples.description: brand, success (goal exceeded), warning, and neutral.

examples.name: WithFooter
examples.title: With title and footer
examples.description: Label as an h3 heading and a link to details.

limits: Beyond 100% the ring stays full: the actual percentage is in the center text and in aria-valuetext.
With target ≤ 0 the percentage is meaningless: the ring is full if value > 0.
